camel_example: aliyun iot QueryStudioAppDomainListOpen --region cn-hangzhou --AppId a12000000 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProjectId a12000000
description_en: Invoke this API to obtain the list of domain names attached to an application
description_zh: 调用该接口获取应用绑定域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-studio-app-domain-list-open --project-id a12000000 --app-id a12000000 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryStudioAppDomainListOpen

parameters.description_en:
The project ID.  
1. Log on to the [IoT development console](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). After selecting the corresponding instance in the upper-left corner of the page, click **Project Management** in the left-side navigation pane.  
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click its project card, and then check the address bar of your browser.
parameters.description_zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
